answer: Plant trap streets, like a mapmaker drawing a fake canyon to catch copiers. Each identity's task carries a private, harmless detail: an invented vertex label or ivory part number unique to it. If identity B's work echoes A's planted detail, one hand likely feeds both, so they share one reward seat. Evasion: run every account truly apart, or scrub odd details, which costs effort and drops real ones too. Wrongly hit: honest agents who share notes openly or read a leaked trap, so a link counts only if the trap was never public, with appeal.
